therapeutic_hypothesis.proposed_mechanism: Multi-targeted tyrosine kinase inhibition combined with DNA synthesis inhibition and DNA crosslinking
therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: Tumor angiogenesis inhibition and direct cytotoxicity
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: Transitional cell carcinoma of the bladder patients receiving neoadjuvant therapy

safety_signals: Multiple serious adverse events including cardiac ischemia/infarction, GU hemorrhage, infections
results.dose_information: Sunitinib malate 37.5 mg oral daily days 1-14, Gemcitabine 1000 mg/m2 IV days 1 and 8, Cisplatin 70 mg/m2 IV day 1
